source_caption:
Zendaya performed many of her own trapeze stunts in The Greatest Showman, training extensively to handle the aerial choreography alongside Zac Efron—which is why their scenes feel so fluid and real.

The Greatest Showman (2017), directed by Michael Gracey, starring Hugh Jackman, Zac Efron, Zendaya. A vibrant musical that celebrates ambition, spectacle, and belonging, blending show-stopping performances with an uplifting story about embracing who you are.

source_details.synopsis: The Greatest Showman is a 2017 American musical period drama film directed by Michael Gracey from a screenplay by Jenny Bicks and Bill Condon, based on an original story by Bicks. The film stars Hugh Jackman, Zac Efron, Michelle Williams, Rebecca Ferguson, and Zendaya. Featuring nine original songs written by Benj Pasek and Justin Paul, and an original musical orchestral score composed by John Debney and Joseph Trapanese, the film is a heavily fictionalized depiction of the life of P. T. Barnum, a showman and entertainer who created the Barnum & Bailey Circus, and its star attractions.
